(program "github.com/synodlang/examples/tcp#main"
  (packages "std/net" "std/sim" "github.com/synodlang/examples/tcp" "std/lesson" "github.com/synodlang/examples/tcp#main")
  (main "main"
    (vars (0 client local tcp.Node) (1 server local tcp.Node))
    (body
      (set client#0 (native "sim.spawn" (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/tcp")))
      (set server#1 (native "sim.spawn" (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/tcp")))
      (set-field server#1 tcp.State "LISTEN")
      (call "lesson.Note" "A connection needs three messages before data can flow.")
      (deliver (message tcp.Open (Server server#1)) client#0)
      (after (time 5000)
        (call "lesson.Ask … choosing" "What does the server send back after a SYN?" (list "An ACK, and the connection is open" "A SYN-ACK: its own sequence number and an acknowledgment of the client's" "A FIN, closing the connection" "Nothing until the client sends data")))
      (after (time 100000)
        (call "lesson.Note" "Both ends are ESTABLISHED: data can now flow either way."))
      (native "sim.stopAt" (time 200000))))
  (package "std/net" std
    (runs "std/net"))
  (package "std/sim" std
    (runs "std/sim"))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/tcp"
    (uses "std/net" "std/sim")
    (runs "std/net" "std/sim" "github.com/synodlang/examples/tcp")
    (node-fields
      (field State text exported "CLOSED")
      (field seq number 0)
      (field peerSeq number 0))
    (record Open exported
      (field Server node exported (native "sim.nobody")))
    (record Syn exported
      (field Seq number exported 0))
    (record SynAck exported
      (field Seq number exported 0)
      (field AckNo number exported 0))
    (record Ack exported
      (field AckNo number exported 0))
    (when-node "sim.delivered"
      (vars (0 n receiver tcp.Node) (1 Open binding tcp.Open))
      (match 0 record tcp.Open Open#1)
      (body
        (set-field n#0 tcp.seq 100)
        (set-field n#0 tcp.State "SYN-SENT")
        (native "net.send" (message tcp.Syn (Seq (nodefield n#0 tcp.seq))) n#0 (recfield Open#1 Server))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver tcp.Node) (1 Syn binding tcp.Syn) (2 client binding node))
      (match 0 record tcp.Syn Syn#1)
      (match 1 bind client#2)
      (body
        (set-field n#0 tcp.peerSeq (recfield Syn#1 Seq))
        (set-field n#0 tcp.seq 300)
        (set-field n#0 tcp.State "SYN-RECEIVED")
        (native "net.send" (message tcp.SynAck (Seq (nodefield n#0 tcp.seq)) (AckNo (plus (nodefield n#0 tcp.peerSeq) 1))) n#0 client#2)))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver tcp.Node) (1 SynAck binding tcp.SynAck) (2 server binding node))
      (match 0 record tcp.SynAck SynAck#1)
      (match 1 bind server#2)
      (body
        (if (is (recfield SynAck#1 AckNo) (plus (nodefield n#0 tcp.seq) 1))
          (then
            (set-field n#0 tcp.peerSeq (recfield SynAck#1 Seq))
            (set-field n#0 tcp.State "ESTABLISHED")
            (native "net.send" (message tcp.Ack (AckNo (plus (nodefield n#0 tcp.peerSeq) 1))) n#0 server#2)))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver tcp.Node) (1 Ack binding tcp.Ack) (2 client binding node))
      (match 0 record tcp.Ack Ack#1)
      (match 1 bind client#2)
      (body
        (if (is (recfield Ack#1 AckNo) (plus (nodefield n#0 tcp.seq) 1))
          (then
            (set-field n#0 tcp.State "ESTABLISHED"))))))
  (package "std/lesson" std
    (uses "std/sim")
    (runs "std/sim" "std/lesson")
    (record Asked exported
      (field Question text exported "")
      (field Choices list of text exported (empty list of text)))
    (record Noted exported
      (field Text text exported ""))
    (phrase "Ask"
      (vars (0 q param text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Asked (Question q#0)) (native "sim.nobody"))))
    (phrase "Ask … choosing"
      (vars (0 q param text) (1 c param list of text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Asked (Question q#0) (Choices (native "lesson.choices" c#1))) (native "sim.nobody"))))
    (phrase "Note"
      (vars (0 t param text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Noted (Text t#0)) (native "sim.nobody")))))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/tcp#main" main
    (uses "github.com/synodlang/examples/tcp" "std/lesson" "std/sim")
    (runs "std/net" "std/sim" "github.com/synodlang/examples/tcp" "std/lesson" "github.com/synodlang/examples/tcp#main")))
